entries.reason: No injection resins in either Parex brand: Davco China (davco.cn) sells tile adhesives, K11 waterproofing slurries, putties, technical mortars, silicone/foam sealants; ParexLanko France catalogue (parexlanko.com) has no PU or epoxy crack-injection resin (only 706 Lankofill Coque cement grout for void filling).
No water-reactive PU injection foam in the Davco China or ParexLanko France ranges.

No epoxy crack-injection resin: ParexLanko 723 LANKOPOXY is a pure epoxy resin for floor surface protection / epoxy-mortar binder (EN 13813), not an injection resin; Davco China has no epoxy products.

No crystalline repair mortar: ParexLanko 730/731 LANKOREP are polymer/fibre repair mortars (their pages list cove and passive-crack treatment but no crystalline action); Davco China K11 防水砂浆 is a two-component polymer-cement waterproofing coating, not a repair mortar.
No crystalline chase/cove mortar in either range (Davco China offers only the K11 crystalline slurry; ParexLanko has no crystalline products).

No rapid flexible thick-layer (FPD-type) bitumen-free cementitious waterproofing: ParexLanko offers 228 LANKOLASTIC / 226 ERTO FLEX PLUS flexible micro-mortars (thin-layer) and bituminous LANKOBLACK products; Davco China offers thin-layer K11 slurries.

No crystalline admixture. ParexLanko's only waterproofing admixture is 322 LANKOFUGE MASSE, a liquid water-repellent ('hydrofuge de masse liquide pour imperméabilisation des bétons et mortiers') — hydrophobic, not crystalline; Davco China sells no concrete admixtures.
No crystalline admixture. ParexLanko 323 LANKOFUGE POUDRE is a powdered water-repellent ('hydrofuge de masse') for concrete and mortar, not crystalline; Davco China sells no concrete admixtures.
No damp-tolerant epoxy barrier primer in either range (ParexLanko's only epoxy is 723 LANKOPOXY; Davco China has no resin floor products).

No pigmented epoxy industrial floor coating; ParexLanko floor products are cementitious (LANKOSOL screeds, 242 LANKOFLOOR dry-shake hardener) plus the clear 723 LANKOPOXY resin; Davco China has floor levelling mortars only.
No water-emulsified epoxy sealer in either range.
No chemically resistant epoxy coating for wastewater plants in either range.

No PU floor-joint sealant listed: ParexLanko sealants are silicones (624/626/628/630/642/643), an acrylic (613) and a hybrid adhesive (536 COL'EXTREME); its catalogue lists a 600 ml extrusion gun 'for polyurethane floor joints' but no PU sealant product page was found. Davco China sealants are neutral silicone (中性硅酮胶) and foam sealant (发泡胶) only.
